definitions.explanation: A hand tool with a handle and a shaped tip that fits into the head of a screw to turn it, used for driving or removing screws.

examples.japanese: ねじ{回|まわ}しを{使|つか}って{棚|たな}を{組|く}み{立|た}てた。
examples.english: I assembled the shelf using a screwdriver.

examples.japanese: プラスのねじ{回|まわ}しとマイナスのねじ{回|まわ}しがある。
examples.english: There are Phillips head and flathead screwdrivers.

examples.japanese: {電動|でんどう}ねじ{回|まわ}しで{作業|さぎょう}が{早|はや}くなった。
examples.english: Work became faster with an electric screwdriver.

notes:
ALTERNATE TERMS:
・ドライバー (driver) - commonly used, especially in casual speech
・{螺子回|ねじまわ}し - using kanji for ねじ

TYPES OF ねじ{回|まわ}し:
・プラスドライバー / {十字|じゅうじ}ねじ{回|まわ}し (Phillips head screwdriver)
・マイナスドライバー / {平|ひら}ねじ{回|まわ}し (flathead screwdriver)
・{電動|でんどう}ドライバー (electric screwdriver)
・{精密|せいみつ}ドライバー (precision screwdriver)

NOTE ON ドライバー: While ドライバー is very common in everyday usage, it can be ambiguous (also means "driver" of a vehicle or golf club). ねじ{回|まわ}し is more specific.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・ねじ{回|まわ}しで{締|し}める (to tighten with a screwdriver)
・ねじ{回|まわ}しで{緩|ゆる}める (to loosen with a screwdriver)
